title: SILK&SORROW
content:
Man I love it when indie artists do their thing and just show up to showcase their talent. On this one we have Ray Lozano coming with a very solid project. This project held me down in the cold winter of 2025 and I honestly think this project should be people’s radar.

The overall silky atmosphere of this album captured my ears from the first listen till today. You can almost feel the emotion from the first track to the last. I love how vulnerable Lozano was being throughout the whole project, this project is not meant for you to forget about your problems but to embrace them and fully feel your emotions in every detail.

The album was produced & Co-produced by Ray Lozano & Samon Kawamura, the pair teamed up to create a sound that was not velvety, mellow and smooth but to back it up with vocals and melodies that created a very beautiful sound overall.

My top three track within this album have to be:

CAN’T LOVE, LOTA and LET THE HEART GROW
verdict: If you don’t what to play on an early morning with a cup of coffee in your hand or if you’re having a late night chill session, this would be the recommendation for you.
